cold: #197's cold test: written before the pose, from the sources alone. Don't read it while posing this lift, and tune neither to the other.
sources: docs/research/grip.md: an ankle cuff, a free hand steadying on the column

lines.says: the leg lifts well out from the standing leg
the lifting knee stays from soft to straight
the trunk leans in through the whole rep
the trunk mostly holds its lean as the leg lifts
the leg rises out to the side, not forward or back
the lifter stands side-on to the tower, the far leg working and the near hand steadying on the column
the cable runs from a low pulley across the standing leg to a cuff on the ankle
the toes stay about forward, not turned up to the ceiling
